description: This script provides functions for upgrading eMMC storage devices, including handling tar and fit images, copying configurations, and performing upgrades, primarily used in OpenWrt firmware upgrades.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Performs eMMC upgrade using a tar archive, handling kernel and root filesystem data.

methods.name: emmc_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Handles eMMC upgrade using a FIT image, setting up kernel blocks.

methods.name: emmc_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data into the eMMC storage.

methods.name: emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines the file type and delegates to the appropriate upgrade function.
